item.text: The listing API already exposes volume trash, and restored shares identify their root links. I’m filtering trash entries by each share’s root parent, then gating preparation on both caches finishing decryption. I also found that `moveLinks` reports per item failures through callbacks but can reject as a whole, so the counts need to cover both paths.

item.text: The patch now merges root children with trash entries for each restored share, counts both, and blocks success if either source still has targeted items. I’ve added tests for combined recovery, a remaining trash item, a rejected move, and a trash load error. I’m running the local suite now.
